episodes.title: Kassa
episodes.summary: Cassian Andor's reckless search for answers about his past makes him a wanted man.

episodes.title: That Would Be Me
episodes.summary: Cassian attempts to lay low on Ferrix as agents of the law close in.

episodes.title: Reckoning
episodes.summary: Cassian's desperation to avoid arrest leads him to a mysterious man with unknown connections.

episodes.title: Aldhani
episodes.summary: Out of options, Cassian joins a mission to infiltrate an Imperial garrison on Aldhani. Meanwhile on the city-covered capital world of Coruscant, agents of the Imperial Security Bureau start to piece together information regarding the disturbance on Ferrix, while Senator Mon Mothma carefully maneuvers webs of intrigue.

episodes.title: The Axe Forgets
episodes.summary: Being a team player does not come naturally to Cassian, but the daring mission to infiltrate an Imperial garrison requires it of him. The operation has been in the planning stages for months. As the newest member of the mission, Cassian must overcome the prudent distrust of his teammates.

episodes.title: The Eye
episodes.summary: With cover from a spectacular local festival, the Aldhani mission reaches a point of no return.

episodes.title: Announcement
episodes.summary: The fallout from the Aldhani heist is swift and seismic, shaking the Imperial Security Bureau on Coruscant into action, and prompting more intrigue for Senator Mon Mothma. Meanwhile, Cassian Andor returns home to find a much changed Ferrix.

episodes.title: Narkina 5
episodes.summary: While lying low, Cassian is swept up in an Imperial crackdown with little more than a false identity as protection. The Empire are unaware of his true past, but send him to toil in a high security prison. Meanwhile, the Imperial Security Bureau continues to piece together intelligence on acts of sedition.

episodes.title: Nobody's Listening!
episodes.summary: Under the unblinking scrutiny of the Empire within a high security prison, Cassian must surreptitiously work to plan his escape. The Imperial Security Bureau keeps digging for answers on Ferrix.

episodes.title: One Way Out
episodes.summary: A rare opportunity opens and the time for Cassian and his fellow inmates to act is now.

episodes.title: Daughter of Ferrix
episodes.summary: A fugitive once more, Cassian must make his next move before it is too late.

episodes.title: Rix Road
episodes.summary: Cassian returns home to Ferrix, a tinderbox that is experiencing a spark of rebellion.

episodes.title: One Year Later
episodes.summary: An undercover mission. A sanctuary threatened. A Chandrilan wedding. A chilling Imperial plan.

episodes.title: Sagrona Teema
episodes.summary: Cassian caught in a rebel turf war. Mon's wedding woes mount. The Ferrix survivors face inspection.

episodes.title: Harvest
episodes.summary: Time is running out for everyone.

episodes.title: Ever Been to Ghorman?
episodes.summary: Cassian and Bix adjust to a Luthen safehouse. All eyes are on Ghorman. Wilmon visits Saw Gerrera.

episodes.title: I Have Friends Everywhere
episodes.summary: Cassian on Ghorman. Syril on Coruscant. Bix failing. Wilmon trapped. Kleya has a serious problem.

episodes.title: What a Festive Evening
episodes.summary: Vel and Cinta to Ghorman. Cassian home to Bix. An argument. A heist. A party. Everything at risk.

episodes.title: Messenger
episodes.summary: Yavin is growing. Wilmon comes for help. Dedra's on Ghorman. Cassian heeds the call.

episodes.title: Who Are You?
episodes.summary: Imperial manipulation. Ghorman frustration. Cassian and Syril center stage as Palmo erupts.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Rebellion
episodes.summary: In the Ghorman aftermath, Mon Mothma takes a stand. Cassian must carry out a difficult extraction.

episodes.title: Make It Stop
episodes.summary: Lonni Jung taps out. Dedra closes in. Luthen scrambles. Kleya delivers.

episodes.title: Who Else Knows?
episodes.summary: Cassian returns to Coruscant for one last extraction.

episodes.title: Jedha, Kyber, Erso
episodes.summary: Cassian returns to Yavin with intel that will change everything.
